title: A Blue Congress, Mr. Veto And A Treasury Twist
gist: Gavekal's Will Denyer says Democrats won both chambers of Congress but lack veto-proof majorities, so 2027-28 will be gridlocked, while the lame-duck session, foreign policy and Treasury financing can still change without legislation; paywalled.

insights.claim: Democrats won majority control of both chambers of Congress in the midterms but lack the two-thirds needed to override a presidential veto, and Trump has promised to be 'Mr. Veto'.
insights.speaker: Will Denyer
insights.so_what: Expect legislative gridlock rather than new law.
insights.quote: Donald Trump has already promised to become “Mr. Veto.”

insights.claim: The result will be legislative gridlock in 2027 and 2028, but markets must first navigate what Republicans can achieve in the lame-duck session.
insights.speaker: Will Denyer
insights.so_what: Watch lame-duck fiscal and policy moves for market risk.

insights.claim: Foreign policy and Treasury financing are areas that can change without new legislation even after the lame duck, the 'Treasury twist' in the title.
insights.speaker: Will Denyer
insights.so_what: Treasury issuance mix is an executive-branch lever to watch for yields.
